the use of a distribution-based parametrized inverse approach for difference geophysical tomography can provide quantitative insight into hydrologic phenomena and can be effective even when limited data are collected.

the use of distribution-based parametrizations for difference tomographic imaging of tracer plumes can improve the quality of the images and their quantitative interpretation, and can be used with comparatively few data.
